text:
sam_ae: Heads-up 3 Quantico Health wants a short trial: automated claim classification + PHI redaction before storage. They want clear success criteria and a 6-week runway. Who owns mapping user journeys -> endpoints?
priya_se: I can take endpoint mapping. Suggested MVP endpoints: /classify-claim, /redact, /explain. Prioritize classify + redact in weeks 1-2.
morgan_eng: For perf targets let's aim 95th < 300ms on a Dedicated node with rwd-llm-v2-8q quantized. Need their QPS and payload sizes. Recommend prefix/KV cache for repeated patient segments.
javier_infosec: Security asks: PHI-in-transit & at-rest, KMS + HSM options, SOC2 evidence, and data residency (must be us-east-1). Also need DPO signoff on log redaction.
emma_csm: I requested sample payloads and QPS numbers from their PM. Also asked them to fill the security questionnaire; they want answers this week.
priya_se: Evals plan: 20 labeled examples for entity redaction + 50 classification samples. Metrics: precision/recall for redaction, classification F1, false positives on redaction. Who runs the harness?
morgan_eng: Eng-ML can run it. I'll provision a sandbox route: quantico-trial.sandbox.redwood with pinned model and fixed tokenization. If they insist PHI never leaves site, we should offer Private connector as an add-on.
sam_ae: Sales preference is cloud-first but include on-prem pricing as optional. Need ballpark pricing tiers for 10k / 50k / 250k tokens/day to show during exec call.
emma_csm: I'll draft three pricing tiers and a migration path: Hosted sandbox -> Dedicated pool -> Private deployment.
javier_infosec: Important: audit logs must not contain raw PHI. Propose in-flight tokenization + storing only hashes. I'll draft exact questionnaire language.
priya_se: Proposed acceptance criteria: 1) classification precision >= 92% on their eval set; 2) redaction misses <= 1%; 3) end-to-end 95th latency < 300ms; 4) security sign-off and DPA signed. Agree?
sam_ae: Yep. Add rollback: fallback to rule-based classifier & drop to synchronous batch if latency spikes.
morgan_eng: I'll prepare the infra runbook and a canary rollout plan. Will post sample curl snippets and a small infra ticket.
emma_csm: Tentative timeline: Week 0 kick + access, Week 1-2 endpoint build + evals, Week 3 perf tuning, Week 4 security review, Week 5 pilot, Week 6 acceptance.
sam_ae: Current blockers: signed DPA, DPO availability, QPS numbers. I'll follow up with legal and Quantico PM.
javier_infosec: Please send me the security questionnaire answers before sharing with customer. I'll review and redline today.
deploy-bot: Deployment ticket created: DL-4819 1 sandbox route + canary policy.
emma_csm: I'll collate success criteria into a one-pager for internal review, then share with Quantico once legal clears security bits.
sam_ae: Thanks all 1 putting a 30-min sync on calendar for tomorrow to lock final scope.
